summary: Moves the KCDS watermark, the mark and server line every player sees in a corner of the screen while in the world, to another corner. The watermark itself cannot be turned off or hidden. The voice chat indicator always stands beside it, toward the middle of the screen.

corner.summary: The corner every player's watermark stands in: 'bottomLeft' (the default), 'bottomRight', 'topRight' or 'topLeft'.

setCorner.summary: Moves the watermark to a corner for all players. A player with their own corner (player.setWatermarkCorner) keeps it. Throws a TypeError for any other value.
setCorner.example:
// The server's own HUD fills the bottom left corner.
kcds.world.Watermark.setCorner('bottomRight');
setCorner.exampleLua:
-- The server's own HUD fills the bottom left corner.
kcds.world.Watermark.setCorner("bottomRight")
setCorner.exampleCs:
// The server's own HUD fills the bottom left corner.
Watermark.SetCorner("bottomRight");
